question: Does a fixed intrinsically bounded sigmoid characteristic response retain a visible and severe-safe Langmuir-versus-linear interimage effect on photographs without the P2W corrected-log-exposure realization or any per-pixel post-hoc safety scale?
claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired fixed equation-family comparison on rights-cleared display-sRGB photographs; not measured chemistry, sensitometry, stock/process/scanner response, calibration, authenticity or product promotion

population.source: exact P7F 16-image / nine-make eligible development cohort
population.role: development-only; any pass requires a separately frozen fresh OOD population

fixed_operator.equation_family: existing clean-room InterimageDevelopmentOperator sigmoid response with amplitude-matched Langmuir donor
fixed_operator.source_witness: U6.P2V symmetric-moderate slope, midpoint, coupling and donor; density span bound to exact P7F interpretation references
fixed_operator.exposure_encoding: P7F LogExposureEncoder applied to forward-scattered nonnegative linear exposure, converted from log10 to log2 exactly by multiplication with log2(10)
fixed_operator.downstream_chain: unchanged P7F adjacency, dye diffusion, interpretation, scanner MTF, neutral gauge and AO6 colour

research_basis.source: Shuto et al., Mechanism of the Interimage-Effect in Color Reversal System and Its Application to Improve Color Reproduction, IS&T 1997
research_basis.use: primary experimental mechanism evidence; no parameter calibration

research_basis.source: Jang, Karaimer and Brown, Emulating Emulsion: A Compact Physically-Based Model for Film Colour, SIGGRAPH Posters 2025
research_basis.use: latest paired explicit colour-response baseline; its two-matrix plus per-channel sigmoid family excludes an interimage donor and does not identify this generic mechanism
latest open physical-simulation comparison and external mechanism evidence only; no code, profile or output copying

forbidden_fallbacks: change the sigmoid witness, donor knee, match point, coupling, exposure encoding, placement, downstream chain, population, metrics or gates after execution
reuse P2W corrected-log-exposure code or add any per-pixel post-hoc safety scale
fit any parameter on photographs, external rendered outputs or the sealed 71-pair display-proxy pool
remove difficult photographs or add visual rounds
advance to visual review if any automatic gate fails
call the result measured sensitometry or DIR chemistry, a stock/process/scanner response, calibration or product promotion

execution_amendments.trigger: pre-formal one-crop smoke stopped before downstream output because the P2V synthetic density minimum lies below the exact P7F interpretation black reference
execution_amendments.change: bind density_min and density_max to the already frozen P7F interpretation black and white references; retain the P2V slope, midpoint, coupling and donor without clipping or fitting
execution_amendments.scientific_effect: maps the intrinsically bounded sigmoid response into the existing legal density domain; no photographic metric, rendered output or gate was observed

branch_rule.automatic_fail: close this intrinsically bounded family without rescue and move to a materially different physical mechanism or data-identification leaf
branch_rule.automatic_pass: open one blind severe/preference comparison; production remains unchanged
branch_rule.visual_severe_fail: close photographic use and retain P2V synthetic evidence only
branch_rule.visual_clean: retain a development challenger and require a fresh independent OOD population before runtime consideration
